description.value: Spitfire Grill is a family restaurant perched beside Victoria International Airport on the Saanich Peninsula, offering breakfast, lunch, and dinner with views of aircraft arriving and departing. The menu spans classic breakfasts, eggs benedicts, omelettes, salads, sandwiches, burgers, pasta, and curries, all freshly prepared. The website also promotes catering services, suggesting the kitchen handles volume orders beyond standard sit-down service.

address.value: 9681 Willingdon Rd, North Saanich, BC, Canada, V8L 5V6

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and corroborates the OSM record: phone number 250-655-0122 matches OSM +12506550122, and the street address 9681 Willingdon Rd with postal code V8L 5V6 matches OSM. The menu subpage confirms multiple vegetarian options (Veggie Omelette, Florentine Benny); no bike-specific amenities, washrooms, takeout, or Wi-Fi are mentioned anywhere on the site, leaving those criteria null. A notable discrepancy exists: the OSM community is listed as 'Sidney' but the website contact page identifies the municipality as 'North Saanich, BC', which is geographically consistent with 9681 Willingdon Rd adjacent to Victoria International Airport.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'Sidney' but the website contact page identifies the municipality as 'North Saanich, BC' — the physical location adjacent to YYJ airport is in North Saanich, not Sidney.

Website header and subpages consistently brand the business as 'Spitfire Grill & Catering', while the OSM name record omits '& Catering'. Minor discrepancy; catering component is not reflected in OSM.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active full-service restaurant serving three meals a day on the Saanich Peninsula; a clear refueling stop for cyclists touring the area. Cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms) require on-site verification before full accreditation.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu lists Veggie Omelette (baby spinach, tomatoes, onions, mushrooms, peppers, jack and cheddar cheese) and Florentine Benny (baby spinach, tomatoes and avocado topped with goat cheese). No explicit gluten-free or vegan designations mentioned
